transcription.text: Page 10, Unit 2, How can we keep clean?
Page 11, Ready? Go.
A, Listen, then point and say,
I keep clean every day.
I wash my hands, I brush my teeth, I wash my face.
Wash my hands, brush my teeth, wash my face.
B, Listen and chant.
This is the way I wash my hands.
Wash my hands, wash my hands.
This is the way I wash my hands early in the morning.
This is the way I brush my teeth.
Brush my teeth, brush my teeth.
This is the way I brush my teeth early in the morning.
This is the way I wash my face.
Wash my face, wash my face.
This is the way I wash my face early in the morning.
Pages 12-13, Story, Leo's Story, A New Family Member
1, Leo, guess who is coming?
Is that Sam?
2, Yes, welcome your new pet.
3, Take good care of Sam.
Okay, Mom, come Sam.
Sam, your paws are dirty. Let's go and wash.
5, Let me wash your paws.
6, It's bedtime. Let's brush our teeth.
7, I brush my teeth every day.
Now your teeth are clean.
8, Sam, we need to keep clean every day.
9, This is a story about a dog.
What do you do before bedtime?
Page 16, Extend Wash your hands.
Wash, wash, wash your hands.
After you play, wash your hands.
Before meals, wash your hands.
Are they soapy? Rub, rub, rub your hands.
Are they clean?
Dry, dry, dry your hands.
Are they dry yet?
Now you're done. Let's have fun.
How do you wash your hands?
Page 17, Sounds
Art, art, hot, hot, pot, pot.
Mom cooks soup in a pot. The soup is hot. Don't touch the pot. It's too
hot.

hot.

Un, un, bun, bun, run, run, sun, sun.
[Music]
